governs: LGDM (BASELINES mvsfuse = MVS-based fusion of Zhou et al. 2020, reproduced) over the campus: scripts/phd/main_base151_v1/b151_lgdm_inputs.py (campus prior surface, pairs) and b151_lgdm_detect.py (judge -> decide on the campus, compose per cell, patch in_change); outputs only under OUT/lgdm/

method_code.unchanged_rules: mf_common.RULE, DECISIONS_1015 (D1015-1..3), STEEP_NZ 0.5, PIECE_MIN_M2 1, CELL 0.25; detect.THR (25 main, 20 / 30 reference), detect.judge, best_match, removal_occlusion, growth, size_filter, decide (with the 1.5 m growth reference), pairs.py rule (same flight by 60 s gaps of the 937 names, < 20 deg, overlap closest to 60 %, every 4th MVS pixel, >= 200 points, ties angle then name)
method_code.how: the detect / mf_common modules are imported and their functions called as they are; only the I/O adapters (mf_common.load_map, read_rgb) and the driver around them (detect.unit, pairs.main) are rewritten for the campus paths

unit.judge_decide: one campus run per prior: the 819 campus training views (TU1 scenes/campus/split.json train = WIDEN0 training images), one 0.25 m change map for the whole campus
unit.why: one decision per place (cells overlap by 20 % + coverage views; per-cell decisions would give up to three answers in the overlaps and need an extra rule for the patches); base151_v1.json LGDM cells = null ('over the campus'); memory: the per-view outputs are reduced as they arrive (imap) and the cell medians are taken in blocks of cell ids, which keeps one prior's run under 22 GB
unit.compose: per cell k: the cell training views (cells.json images = scenes/cell<k>/split.json train) with the campus change map

inputs.views: common.Views(sparse = TU1 scenes/campus/scene_LoD2/sparse/0): PINHOLE 1024 x 741, K = TU1 scenes/campus/poses.json K (checked equal), poses equal to the p0-audit dense model and to every cell scene (checked)
inputs.images: TU1 scenes/campus/images/<stem>.jpg (1024 x 741 JPEG, fork_inputs_v6 rule; scene_receipt same_bytes true)
inputs.mvs: WIDEN0 mvs/full/stereo/depth_maps/<stem>.JPG.geometric.bin (819 training images; the JUDGECHECK-v2 base-value campus MVS) with the stage-0 export rule s03_stage1_v6.py:135-153,378: dm = common.read_depth_bin, assert (741, 1024), a1map = isfinite(dm) & (dm > 0), mvs = where(a1map, dm, NaN) float32 (the same map for both priors)
inputs.tau: not made: the export tau map (s03_stage1_v6.py:353,380) needs TAU roof / wall = the pass-2 tolerance of a stage-1 run of this MVS over the range; no such run exists for the campus. detect.judge reads tau only for the colour reference (order 5.6 item 4, histogram of 'agreeing' pixels); it gets an all-NaN map, so that reference is empty. No decision or output uses tau
inputs.prior_surface_judge: campus surface OUT/lgdm/prior/{lod2,als}_campus.npz: the inputs_prior rule (tile union by centroid in the tile core, all faces, LoD2 shift 0, ALS vertex + als_shift_m of the nearest JUDGECHECK-v2 ALS patch) over all 24 WIDEN0 prior tiles, no range cut. Kept per triangle: LoD2 tri_type, building (name -> id over the sorted names), wall surface = the tile surface table's polygon gml id (a polygon cut by tile cores stays one surface, as in one site mesh); ALS building_tri, vertex class; tri_cells bitmask = centroid (before the ALS shift) in expanded cell k + 20 m (the b151_prior keep rule)
inputs.prior_surface_check: for every cell k the campus triangles with bit k must equal OUT/prior/cell<k>/<prior> mesh (same V[F] coordinates in the same order), else STOP
inputs.building_regions: LoD2: faces of one building name; ALS: vertex-connected components of the building_tri triangles, vertices with exactly equal registered xyz treated as one vertex (the tile meshes share the ALS points; without it a building would split at tile cores)
inputs.ground_height: mf_common rules unchanged (LoD2 median over wall surfaces of the lowest vertex; ALS median centroid z of ground triangles in the 2 m band); computed per building with a window / per-cell index instead of whole-grid scans (same sets, same values)
inputs.prior_depth_judge: direct ray cast of the campus surface with the stage-0 export rule (common.Scene float32, Views.rays float32 at pixel centres + 0.5, camera z, NaN no hit) in place of the export prior map; detect.judge's re-cast check (mismatch <= 0.1 % of pixels, |diff| <= 0.01 m, else STOP) then compares two casts of the same surface and is kept and recorded; in addition each view's campus cast is compared with its cell prior maps (OUT/priordepth) and recorded (differences = surfaces outside the cell range)
inputs.grid: 0.25 m in the local frame over the union of the 24 tile cores +- 10 m (floor / ceil to 0.25 m); no evaluation range (the GT-made top_raster is not read; in_eval = none)
inputs.prior_depth_compose: OUT/priordepth/<prior>/cell<k>/<stem>.npy (the cell prior maps shared with CDGS); check per view = detect.judge's re-cast check against a cast of OUT/prior/cell<k> (mismatch <= 0.1 %, |diff| <= 0.01 m, else STOP)

compose_rule: detect.compose unchanged: hit = finite(D) & D > 0; the hit point C + D x ray (Views.rays float64) -> plan cell of the campus grid; change (threshold 25 final) -> MVS depth (none -> NaN), other prior pixels -> D, no prior -> MVS (none -> NaN); float32 [741, 1024] camera z, NaN = none -> OUT/lgdm/<prior>/cell<k>/depth/<stem>.npy
patch_rule: JUDGECHECK-v2 geometry_raw/<tile>__<prior>.npz patches: in_change = final change cell (threshold 25) at grid.cell(centre) (outside the grid -> False) = detect.patch_flags (mvsfuse/detect.py:354-362) as JUDGEAPPLY judgments.py:54-58 carried it (region 4 = 2 MVS if in_change else 1 prior); judged = that cell seen by >= 2 paired views -> OUT/lgdm/<prior>/patches_<tile>.npz (patch_id, in_change, judged, centre, normal, kind, prior_height_m, mvs_mean_m)
gt_removed: detect.counts, detect.records, mf_common.lod2_change_classes, the regions_ext_v3 / rows_LoD2 / top_raster reads, compose's locmap patch sums and the MVS-filled plan cells (records only) are not run; nothing GT-derived is read
container: scripts/phd/main_base151_v1/run_cpu.sh tag lgdm-*, jointbuildgs:dev, --network none, 12 CPUs, 22g, oom-score-adj 800, nice 15; judge 6 workers, compose 8 workers; at most two containers; start only when MemAvailable >= 40 GB
outputs: OUT/lgdm/{prior/, prep/pairs_campus.json, <prior>/detect/{detect.json, cells.npz, views.json, quicklook.png}, <prior>/cell<k>/depth/<stem>.npy, <prior>/cell<k>/compose.json, <prior>/patches_<tile>.npz, receipt_<prior>.json}
differences_from_previous: region: one box site (s02 range) -> the campus (24 tiles); training views 243-333 of a site -> the 819 campus training views (judge), cell training views 308/471/544/324 (compose)
MVS: PREP-MEASURE per-box COLMAP (stage-0 export mvs) -> WIDEN0 campus COLMAP full (same software and options, 819 images)
prior surface: s02 box mesh + stage-0 box registration shift -> inputs_prior tile union (LoD2 0, ALS per building JUDGECHECK-v2 shift)
prior depth: stage-0 export map -> direct cast with the same rule (judge), the cell prior maps (compose)
pairs: among the site's training views -> among the 819 campus training views
GT counts and records: not run (see gt_removed)
grid: range polygon + 10 m -> tile-core union + 10 m; no evaluation range
per-building loops and cell medians: grouped / blocked computation with the same results (speed and memory)
